scoring_justification: Cannot re-run expensive MD simulations in verifier sandbox; compare agent-reported thermal conductivity and K/K0 values (after normalisation) against paper-derived reference data with tolerances that absorb legitimate toolchain variability.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference normalised thermal conductivity values for grain size, strain, and temperature effects
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I for grain size; Figs 4,6 for strain and temperature scaling; analytic fits consistent with the hidden oracle solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Grain-size values are exact numbers from Table I. Strain and temperature reference normalised values are derived from the paper's stated relative drops (57%, 41%, 32%) and the composite-material model leading to the scaling K ∝ 300/T for SC and K ∝ (300/T)^0.5 for poly‑10 nm; these formulas reproduce the oracle's output exactly.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All reference numbers are the paper's own reported results; the analytic trends are the quantitative description the paper itself gives (percentage drops, temperature insensitivity). No fabricated labels or invented holdouts are used.

outputs.description: Normalized thermal conductivity K/K0 for polycrystalline graphene with grain sizes 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5 nm.
Thermal conductivity under uniaxial tensile strain for single-crystalline and polycrystalline graphene (2.5 nm, 7.5 nm).
Thermal conductivity at 200–600 K for single-crystalline and polycrystalline graphene (2.5 nm, 10 nm).

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are compared to hidden reference values derived from the paper's tables and figures. The agent must run the full RNEMD simulations; no pre-computed results are provided.
